item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 20/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong persistently in the next couple of days. Upper-air disturbances will bring showers and thunderstorms to Guangdong today and tomorrow. With the departure of upper-air disturbances, it will be very hot over the region in the middle and latter parts of this week. A trough of low pressure is expected to edge closer to the coast of southern China on Saturday. There will be a few showers over the region during the weekend. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will be cloudier over the coast of Guangdong early next week.
